rows.item: NBA betting offered on Alberta's regulated platform
rows.official_value: NBA 'Bet' tile is shown on Play Alberta's sports section
Operators may conduct registered iGaming from July 13 (2026); all operators must register with AGLC and sign a commercial agreement with AiGC

rows.item: Advertising rule for registered iGaming operators
rows.official_value: Ads must reference responsible-gambling information, including 211 Alberta; athletes appealing to minors may not endorse

rows.item: AGLC guidance on event contracts / prediction markets
rows.official_value: Guidance document 'AGLC iGaming Guidance Document – Event Contracts' is listed on the AGLC iGaming page (title verified; contents not reviewed)

rows.item: NBA memo (Oct 16, 2026) restricting parlays with same-player unders
rows.reported_unverified: Media (Yahoo Sports, quoting an ESPN report of a league memo dated Oct 16, 2026): authorized US sportsbooks told not to offer parlays with the under on the same player's stats. Scope: NBA's US authorized operators.

rows.item: NBA memo: opening-tip winner, 'first-of' markets, missed-shot props
rows.reported_unverified: Media (Yahoo Sports, quoting ESPN): no bets on the winner of the opening tip, 'first-of' player markets, and bets on players to miss specific shots. Scope: US authorized operators.

rows.item: NBA memo: under bets on players expected to play fewer than 12 minutes
rows.reported_unverified: Media (Yahoo Sports, quoting ESPN): no under bets on players expected to play fewer than 12 minutes in a game. Scope: US authorized operators.

rows.item: NBA official primary document for the Oct 2026 memo
rows.reported_unverified: No official NBA primary document located. This session fetched the Yahoo Sports article (Oct 16, 2026) which cites an ESPN report and a league memo; the memo itself was not seen. Primary-source check still open.

rows.item: Netherlands: online sports betting is licensed by the Ksa
rows.official_value: Ksa register lists providers by category, including "Online sportweddenschap"; check each operator on the register before use
Gokstop: self-exclusion from (online) casinos and speelhallen via the Cruks register (gokstop.nl)

rows.item: Netherlands: which licensed Dutch operators offer NBA markets (spreads, totals, player props)
rows.reported_unverified: Not verified. Third-party sites name operators, but none was checked against the Ksa register in this session.

rows.item: Whether the Oct 16, 2026 US restrictions (R-05 to R-07) apply to Dutch licensed operators
rows.reported_unverified: Unknown. The reported memo is addressed to the NBA's US authorized operators. No Dutch source was found.
